{{Quote|And I have news about Wraith's mission. Local intelligence suggests that indigenous forces are already moving into position and can't be contacted. Repeat, they cannot be contacted.|Leia Organa Solo|<ref name="TG">''[[Tatooine Ghost]]''</ref>}}
The '''mission to Askaj''' was a covert operation conducted by [[Wraith Squadron]], a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit, on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Askaj/Legends|Askaj]]<ref name="TG" /> in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Tatooine Ghost]]'' to [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]].</ref> Their goal was to capture [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilkadon]] while he was on the planet for his annual [[tomuon]] holdings inspection. [[General/Legends|General]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], with a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] battle group, was assigned to command the operation, with the plan calling for him to use [[Shadowcast]] communication network to activate a cell of local resistance fighters who would provide most of the intelligence and firepower needed on the planet.<ref name="TG" /> 

The mission was almost canceled by New Republic [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] due to the theft of the painting ''[[Killik Twilight]]'', which held the Shadowcast transmission codes.<ref name="TG" />
